fact: The Cybercrime and Computer Misuse Act 2026, signed 18 February 2026, designates the authority as lead national responder to cyber threats and requires it to establish a National Computer Incident Response Team Coordination Centre (SS-CIRT/CC).

The National Communication Authority, through its South Sudan Computer Incident Response Team (SS-CIRT), convened stakeholders at Gumbo and adopted a National Cyber Incident Management Framework; the CIRT's Assistant Director said SS-CIRT has a clear mandate as the national hub for cyber incident coordination.
